name: saygm
description: The SayGM LLM gateway (saygm.com) as a mod. Claude, GPT, Gemini and open-weight models behind one key, priced at or below the maker's list, every request sealed inside an Intel TDX enclave (-tee models run inference inside it). Live catalog in USD per Mtok, cost quotes vs list price, one chat call that picks the right wire shape per model, and an OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini-compatible /v1 passthrough. Bring your own SayGM key; stdlib only.
state: ~/.mod/saygm/ — key.json (0600) and a 5-minute models.json cache (override with SAYGM_DIR)

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is and whether a key is set
endpoints.GET /health: Liveness — local only, never calls upstream
endpoints.GET /models: Live catalog in USD/Mtok (q, tier=frontier|confidential|open, lab, shape, confidential, sort=id|input|output|discount, limit)
endpoints.GET /model: One model with list price and discount (id)
endpoints.GET /quote: Cost of a call here vs list price (model, input_tokens, output_tokens)
endpoints.GET /credits: Prepaid balance — remote callers send x-saygm-key
endpoints.POST /chat: {model, prompt | messages, system, max_tokens, temperature, confirm} — any chat model, one shape; remote callers send x-saygm-key
endpoints.POST /set_key: {key} store the house key 0600 — loopback only
endpoints.POST /refresh: Drop the catalog cache — loopback only
endpoints.* /v1/*: Raw passthrough to api.saygm.com (OpenAI chat/responses, Anthropic messages, Gemini /v1beta). House key only for loopback callers
